description: This file defines classes and interfaces for HDMI CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) functionality within a WPEFramework plugin, including device management, message processing, event handling, and JSONRPC interface methods.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2FrameListener
classes.description: Implements FrameListener to handle HDMI CEC frames and notify a MessageProcessor.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2Processor
classes.description: Processes various HDMI CEC messages and manages connection events.

classes.name: CECDeviceInfo_2
classes.description: Stores and manages information about a CEC device, including address, vendor ID, and OSD name.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing HDMI CEC control, device management, and JSONRPC interface within WPEFramework.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles incoming CEC frames and forwards to processor.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes specific CEC messages based on type.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets device info to default state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates device info fields and indicates if they changed.

methods.name: HdmiCec_2
methods.description: Constructor for the main plugin class.

methods.name: ~HdmiCec_2
methods.description: Destructor for the main plugin class.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: SendStandbyMsgEvent
methods.description: Sends a standby message to a device.

methods.name: sendActiveSourceEvent
methods.description: Sends an active source event.

methods.name: addDevice
methods.description: Adds a device to the device list.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Removes a device from the device list.

methods.name: sendUnencryptMsg
methods.description: Sends an unencrypted CEC message.

methods.name: sendDeviceUpdateInfo
methods.description: Updates device info for a given device.

methods.name: sendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Sends a key press event to a device.

methods.name: sendKeyReleaseEvent
methods.description: Sends a key release event.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set CEC enabled state via JSONRPC.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get CEC enabled state via JSONRPC.

methods.name: setOTPEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set OTP feature state.

methods.name: getOTPEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get OTP feature state.

methods.name: setOSDNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set OSD name.

methods.name: getOSDNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get OSD name.

methods.name: setVendorIdWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set vendor ID.

methods.name: getVendorIdWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get vendor ID.

methods.name: performOTPActionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to perform OTP action.

methods.name: sendStandbyMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to send standby message.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected devices.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Gets status of active source.

methods.name: sendRemoteKeyPressWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to send remote key press.
